provenance_classification: OWNER_RATIFIED_OUTSIDE_THE_REPOSITORY_PRIOR_TO_THIS_MATERIALIZATION_LANE. The decisions below were ratified by the product/mission owner and supplied verbatim to this lane as its directing text (OWNER_DECISION=APPROVED). THIS FILE IS NOT A VERBATIM TRANSCRIPT of any chat and it is not a new adjudication. It is the canonical normalized ratification record so that successor lanes can cite a stable repository artifact instead of re-deriving or informally re-summarizing a decision the owner has already made. OWNER_RATIFICATION and REPOSITORY_MEASUREMENT remain distinct categories throughout: a ratification is binding product intent; a measurement is a falsifiable claim about the codebase that any successor lane may and should re-measure.
precedence_note: This record is canonical for product-owner intent on RC-01..RC-10 only. It does NOT override executable FIB/ODS/database/security authority. The repository hierarchy (CLAUDE.md section 2) places sealed FIB authority ABOVE an owner record of this class, and the serialization this record creates an exception to (FIBIU-20 hard_dependencies = [FIBIU-19, FIBIU-29]) lives in the FORMALLY_SEALED FIB baseline. A bare owner record therefore cannot by itself make the exception effective — this is the precedent lesson recorded at docs/ops/owner-ratifications/ENVIRONMENT_CONVERGENCE_OWNER_DECISIONS_v1.1.0.json#precedence_note, where Lane CV1-ENV-O2 failed closed for exactly this reason. The companion authority named above is the artifact that makes RC-02, RC-03 and RC-04 execution-effective, and it does so by BOUNDING them, not by widening them. Read together, the companion authority's normative definitions govern.
reopening_rule: THIS IS NOT A NEW HPO. Do NOT reopen or re-adjudicate the FIB baseline's wave topology, the FIBIU-19 -> FIBIU-20 serialization for any scope other than the bounded slice defined in RC-02, the G2 boundary, or the FIBDB-053 Stage-A contract. Absence of implementation is not a contradiction. A conflict between this record and active executable authority that the companion authority does not resolve fails closed (STOP_FOR_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT); it is not silently resolved in either direction.

why_this_record_exists.problem: FIBDB-053 Stage-A cannot be safely applied while the only runtime caller of the completion verb is hard-coded to the signature Stage-A drops. The remedy lives in files the FIB baseline assigns to FIBIU-20, whose hard dependency on FIBIU-19 has not been discharged. Authoring the remedy therefore requires either a sequencing exception or an indefinite block.
why_this_record_exists.measured_contradiction: See the companion authority's COMPATIBILITY_CONTRADICTION block. Restated in one line: the FIB baseline simultaneously requires FIBDB-053 to DROP the seven-argument completion signature without a DEFAULT, and claims its Stage-A is additive so that the existing path keeps functioning. Both cannot be true, and the collision lands on the runtime callsite.
why_this_record_exists.owner_choice: The owner elected a bounded sequencing exception over an indefinite block, and selected the runtime-first, catalog-driven bridge architecture over a manual feature flag.

definitional_intent.COMPATIBILITY_SLICE: The narrow, enumerated subset of FIBIU-20 whose ONLY purpose is to make FIBDB-053 Stage-A safely deployable: the catalog-probed dual-signature bridge in the completion wrapper and the risk payload plumbing that feeds it. Its exact, closed write surface is frozen by the companion authority's FUTURE_RUNTIME_WRITE_SURFACE. Normative definition lives in the companion authority, not here.
definitional_intent.REMAINING_FIBIU20_SCOPE: Everything in FIBIU-20 that is NOT the compatibility slice: segregation of duties, the reviewer/author independence rule, stella_findings and stella_finding_dispositions as first-class rows, the high-risk finding disposition gate, and every UI and report change FIBIU-20 names. This scope remains SERIAL behind FIBIU-19 and is untouched by RC-02.
definitional_intent.SEQUENCING_EXCEPTION: A bounded permission for the COMPATIBILITY_SLICE alone to be authored, implemented, tested and deployed before FIBIU-19 completes. It is not a re-ordering of the wave topology and it does not discharge FIBIU-20's hard dependency on FIBIU-19.
